news.title: Horizon Gold targets 880,000oz gold production and A$1.85bn cash flow at Gum Creek
news.summary:
Horizon Gold targets 880,000oz over 10 years at Gum Creek Gold Project

Horizon Gold (ASX:HRN) is advancing plans for a large-scale open-pit gold operation at its Gum Creek Gold Project in Western Australia, with a Definitive Feasibility Study (DFS) outlining a 10-year mine life and approximately 880,000 ounces of gold production.

The project targets average annual production of around 98,000 ounces over the first five years, supported by an ore reserve of 728,000 ounces.

The DFS forecasts A$1.85 billion in life-of-mine free cash flow, a net present value (NPV) of A$1.31 billion and an internal rate of return (IRR) of 53.1%, with pre-production capital estimated at A$350 million.

First gold production is targeted for the second half of 2028, while additional underground gold resources offer potential upside beyond the current mine plan.
